scope: Official data.police.uk explicit-month, availability, coverage and sensitive-field guards

rows.observed: Every stop-search and crime request is pinned to 2026-05 rather than relying on an endpoint default
rows.effect: A later default month cannot silently change the evidence window

rows.observed: The official availability endpoint identifies available street-crime months and lists stop-search provider force IDs for each month
rows.effect: Force and month availability is checked before interpreting an empty response

rows.observed: The stops-by-force method may default to the latest month even when that force supplied no data
rows.effect: An empty default response is unavailable data, not zero stops

rows.observed: The stop-and-search provider list does not certify complete street-crime or outcome coverage
rows.effect: Stop-search availability cannot clear crime coverage gates

rows.observed: Published stop-search coordinates are anonymised approximations rather than exact locations
rows.effect: Coordinates cannot establish a stop inside the cadastral parcel

rows.observed: Age, gender, ethnicity, involved-person and person identifiers are excluded from parcel scoring and storage
rows.effect: No person-level profiling or protected-characteristic inference

rows.observed: May 2026 includes force-specific crime and stop-search gaps documented in the official changelog
rows.effect: Missing force data remains null and triggers coverage review

rows.observed: Exact force resolution, dated response, reconciliation and final manifest hashes are absent
rows.effect: Score remains null
